description: This file defines the Filter controller class for the admin section of an OpenCart-based e-commerce platform. It handles CRUD operations, listing, and autocomplete functionality for product filters in the catalog module.

classes.name: Filter
classes.description: Controller class for managing product filters in the admin dashboard, including listing, creating, editing, deleting, and autocompleting filter data.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point to display the filter list page with header, footer, and filter list content.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Delegates to getList to generate the filter list content.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves filter groups with sorting, pagination, and prepares data for the filter list view.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a filter group, pre-filling data if editing.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Processes POST data to add or update a filter group, returning JSON with success or error messages.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected filter groups after permission and product association validation, returning JSON response.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides JSON autocomplete suggestions for filters based on the input name, supporting AJAX requests.
